# superset_slack_channels (Data Source)

Lists the channels of the Slack workspace Superset is connected to, with the ids that recipients of the `SlackV2` type of `superset_report` take. Superset asks Slack with its own token, so the instance needs Superset 4.1 or later, the `ALERT_REPORTS` feature flag and a `SLACK_API_TOKEN` that may list channels.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "superset_slack_channels" "sales" {
  search = "sales"
}

# Send the weekly report to the first channel named like "sales".
resource "superset_report" "weekly_sales" {
  name         = "Weekly sales"
  type         = "Report"
  crontab      = "0 9 * * 1"
  dashboard_id = superset_dashboard.sales.id
  recipients = [
    { type = "SlackV2", target = data.superset_slack_channels.sales.channels[0].id },
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `search` (String) Keep the channels whose name contains this text.

### Read-Only

- `channels` (Attributes List) The channels, as Slack lists them. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--channels))

<a id="nestedatt--channels"></a>
### Nested Schema for `channels`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) Identifier of the channel in Slack, for example `C0123456789`.
- `name` (String) Name of the channel, without the `#`.
